scope: Twelve level-75/85/100 village story bosses; offline production-engine balance check.

methodology.boundary: One authored story-profile family. No global combat formula, catalog, AI planner, reward or storage changes.
methodology.primaryAcceptance: All eight builds defeat the enemy with positive HP before25 rounds. Median final HP <=40%; strongest reference build <=70%. Favorable focused builds may finish above40%.
methodology.fieldAcceptance: Same policy and builds in all five actual sector biomes; actual knockout, positive HP, before25 rounds.
methodology.policy: Visible-state heuristic, heal below55%, use real weapons, utility, Clear on active offensive/defensive buffs and Cleanse on harmful conditions. No future enemy response search.
methodology.preparation: Rare shop gear (effectiveLv30); mastery30 at75/85, mastery40 at100; free12-slot capacity; two acquired natures Earth/Wind. Eight damaging techniques at100 cover long cooldowns.
methodology.extras: No bloodline, pet, relic, consumable, mid-fight HP/resource resets or hidden player stat bonuses. Independent full-health starts.
methodology.limits: Controlled examples, not human win rates or a universal result for every nature pair, weather, gear set or strategy. Higher mastery and special gear can make favorable matchups easier.
methodology.correctedProbeIssues: Discarded early probes lacked nature ownership validation or sufficient endgame cooldown coverage. Prepared Solo policy also checks active-only Clear rules and avoids the group chip-finisher on a large boss. Only frozen, acquisition-valid baseline and promoted evidence are used below.

finales.preserved: All12 catalog techniques, six damaging moves, AP/costs/powers/cooldowns, legal mastery50, armor.18, resource pools, portraits and exclusive Apex planner.

changes.preserved: All24 profiles at level65 or below exactly match the baseline after JSON normalization. Opponent IDs/names/visuals, rewards, progression and legacy village raid guards retain their existing behavior.

before.name: Kage Raiko Veyr, Hollow Storm Tyrant
before.tacticalTell: Voltaic Surge Focus charges the next assault. Watch the lightning aura; spent signatures must recover before they can repeat. Each signature costs 60 AP and has a seven-round cooldown. Track spent techniques, clear the offensive setup or break the guard, then commit during the recovery window.
